title: Anakah and Tristan's off-world past lives and their mission to ease first contact

tellings.quote: They claim at this point to have memories of having lived outside of the Earth on other planets and other lifetimes and that they're on a mission

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic experience, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about two people named Anakah and Tristan. He says they claim to remember past lives lived on other planets, and believe they are here on a mission to make humanity's first open contact with alien life go more smoothly.
